--------
CORAM : HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE SUBHASH CHAND ------
For the Petitioner : Mr. Nitayanand Prasad Choudhary, Advocate For the State : Mr. Nawin Kr.
Singh, A.P.P.
--------
th 08/11 November, 2024 1.

Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and learned A.P.P. for the State.
2.

This second bail petition has been filed on behalf of the abovenamed petitioner with prayer to release on bail in connection with S.T. Case No.289 of 2022 arising out of Dumka (M) P.S. Case No.204 of 2021 under Sections 376(D), 302/34, 201/34 and 120-B of the I.P.C. pending in the court of learned Additional Sessions Judge-II, Dumka.

3. Learned counsel for the petitioner has submitted that earlier the prayer for bail of the petitioner has been rejected by this Court vide order dated 3rd November, 2023 passed in B.A. No.7408 of 2022.

By way of present bail petition, the petitioner has renewed his prayer for bail on the ground that initially the bail was granted to the petitioner in B.A. No.7408 of 2022 vide order dated 23rd August, 2022 and against the said order the State approached the Hon'ble Apex Court in S.L.P.
(Crl.) No.6255 of 2022 and
in the said S.L.P. the order dated 23rd August, 2022 was set aside and this Court was directed to decide the bail application afresh.
It is further submitted that the petitioner has been languishing in jail since 23rd September, 2023 and charge was framed on 4th July, 2023 and no prosecution witness has been examined as yet.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: 4. Learned A.P.P. opposed the contentions made by the learned counsel for the petitioner.

5. The plea raised by the learned counsel for the petitioner that the petitioner is in jail for more than a year cannot be accepted as a new ground taking into consideration the gravity of the offence alleged.
Accordingly, this bail application is, hereby, rejected.
6. However, the learned trial court is directed to expedite the trial without granting any unnecessary adjournment at the instance of the either side.
(Subhash Chand, J.) Rohit Sajan Kumar @ Sajan Sah @ Sajan Kumar Sah ... vs The State Of Jharkhand .... .... Opp. ... on 11 November, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/67441755/
